reason: A single rotor with a cost-free reliable relay favors immediate stopping; test preservation of another necessary operation before introducing learning claims.
required_pre_run_gate: Implement a two-rotor MJCF with independent physical encoder samples and one explicit shared electrical bus.
Freeze exact MJCF, policy, referee, dependencies and numeric calibration identities before generating the cohort.
Run boundary tests for premature B termination, missed A deadline, public capture versus arrival, shared-channel queuing, absorbing original failure and paired initial state.
Record a new execution protocol with identities and actual release receipt; this design document alone is not a preregistration or execution receipt.

physical_state.initial_state: both rotors at rest; independent positive drive on a shared electrical bus
physical_state.reference_event_each: physical encoder position first crosses 2 rad
physical_state.completion_each: speed <= 0.1 rad/s for 0.2 s; use the start interval of the persistent low-speed segment
physical_state.clock: integer simulation nanoseconds; capture and arrival separated
physical_state.chemical_outcome: UNKNOWN without an independent chemical endpoint

necessary_contracts.B_continuity: After B reference, no low-speed sample is permitted strictly before the lower completion limit. An early interruption remains FALSE even if a later restart succeeds.
necessary_contracts.joint_temporal_verdict: FALSE if any necessary contract is independently FALSE; TRUE only if all are TRUE; otherwise UNKNOWN
necessary_contracts.score_reset: Forbidden within an attempt; a restart must create another attempt ID and retain the original score.

actuation.selective_A: Stop only A through the shared serial command channel.
actuation.selective_B: Stop only B through the same serial command channel.
actuation.global_relay: Fast, fixture-reliable stop of both A and B; its effect on B must be scored.
actuation.channel_queue: Selective commands share one non-preemptive channel. Trace request, service start, ACK and physical effect independently.
actuation.permissions: Every arm receives all three actions, the same sensors, calibrated model and query budget.
actuation.latencies_and_faults: Use separately frozen execution protocol values after interface verification; no hidden fault labels in actor input.

planned_first_matrix.task_graph: independent A upper deadline plus B minimum/maximum operation and continuity
planned_first_matrix.holdout_credit: This is a development component matrix; response shifts are not unseen task-graph generalization.

subsequent_task_graph_holdouts: B completion must occur within a window after A physical completion rather than its own reference.
Reverse the required operation order without changing appearance or dynamics.
Introduce a third operation competing for the selective command channel.

allowed: own command and public feedback history
forbidden: post-hoc result verdicts without measured online release

matched_strong_control: The joint deterministic scheduler uses the same calibrated predictor, sensors, action permissions and bounded enumeration budget as any later proposed filter or agent. It remains in the main comparison.
reporting: A timing, B timing, B continuity and their conjunction as TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN counts over the complete cohort.
Per-setting repair and harm relative to both global stopping and selective retry; retain infeasible and UNKNOWN cases.
Command queue, observation wait, stop decay and failure-contingent delays separately.
Prediction eligibility versus independent actual results, with calibration support identified.
No chemical, VLA, RSI, policy-absorption or learned-model benefit from this untrained component study.
learning_entry_gate: Only after the above component and release semantics are verified, compare shared history-conditioned DP and equal-teacher-budget student-state DAgger, then runtime restriction x learning-target and parameters x context. RL/distillation are conditional tools, not mandatory stages.
safelab_dependency: Canonical collector timing must gain an independent event sidecar; frame_index/fps cannot substitute for physical capture or feedback arrival. No changes to SafeLab current jobs or data registries are authorized by this document.
